--- title: "Pipeline" vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Pipeline} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the # repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT, # a local render finds the checkout from the working directory. root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT") if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path() knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root) pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE) library(targets) library(dplyr) ``` ::: The processing pipeline is a [`targets`](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/) graph (decision 0004) — the single source of truth for how raw data becomes features, models, and results. The map below is **generated from the graph**, so it can't drift from what the code actually does. ## Stages ```{mermaid} flowchart LR ingest[ingest CFBD + nflverse] --> clean[clean standardize + coerce keys] clean --> link[link player-season backbone + joins] link --> features[features longitudinal change] features --> model[model explain + predict] model --> report[report site + viz] clean -.-> contracts[(data contracts)] clean -.-> audit[(audit log)] link -.-> audit features -.-> audit ``` ## Live dependency graph `tar_visnetwork()` renders the graph as an interactive `visNetwork` widget: nodes carry the target name and runtime, clicking a node shows its output, and the widget renders faster than a large static Mermaid diagram. Only targets are drawn (`targets_only = TRUE`); the functions they call are left out so the data flow stays readable. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tar_visnetwork(targets_only = TRUE, allow = NULL, label = "time") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` + raw_games_chunk declared [34 branches] + raw_plays_chunk declared [282 branches] + raw_game_team_stats_chunk declared [282 branches] + raw_game_player_stats_chunk declared [282 branches] + raw_play_stats_chunk declared [17 branches] ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## What remains Targets that are outdated (need to run) — a live view of what's left to build or refresh. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} outdated <- tryCatch(tar_outdated(), error = function(e) character(0)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` + raw_games_chunk declared [34 branches] + raw_plays_chunk declared [282 branches] + raw_game_team_stats_chunk declared [282 branches] + raw_game_player_stats_chunk declared [282 branches] + raw_play_stats_chunk declared [17 branches] ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} if (length(outdated)) { tibble::tibble(target = outdated) } else { cat("All targets are up to date.") } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` All targets are up to date. ``` ::: ::: ::: {.callout-important} ## Known gaps `/roster` is now ingested, keyed on an authoritative `season` (stamped from the queried year — the endpoint's own `year` is the eligibility class). But roster **weight is static per player**, so the decision-0003 between-season `weight_delta` is not derivable and was dropped; we keep the static roster `weight`. The `model` and `report` stages are wired placeholders. Post-draft **NFL outcomes** (nflverse) are now ingested and bridged to picks by draft slot, but as *labels* — they stay off the model input path to avoid leakage (decision 0014). :::
